entries.reason: the Tier 2 verdict on Metal/MetalKit (coordination/corpus, 2026-09-23): a descriptor object needs no GPU driver to exist and hold the values it is given, and this port's own -[CharonMetalDevice newLibraryWithSource:options:error:] already accepts one and already honestly refuses to compile Metal Shading Language source at runtime - the descriptor plugs into a seam that was already named, not a new promise of compilation
entries.effect: fastMathEnabled defaults to YES as the header documents; preprocessorMacros, languageVersion and the rest hold what is set and read it back; nothing reads them, since the only consumer, newLibraryWithSource:options:error:, refuses before it would
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract; CharonMetalDevice.m's own newLibraryWithSource:options:error:, which already exists and already refuses
